generationMethod: Built-in imagegen; one master followed by three screen-only edits of that master
invariants: No webpage text in the bitmap
validation: Visual alignment checked. Raw AI edits have one-pixel canvas-width variance and approximately three-pixel exterior-outline variance. They are not pixel-identical outside screens.
renderStrategy: Keep classroom.png as the immutable full-frame base. Only composite the phone and laptop screen regions from subsequent frames, at a common fixed aspect ratio. Never crossfade full frames if pixel-stable hardware is required.

promptSet.master: Preserve the reference phone, laptop, perspective, scale, reflections and shadows. Remove all external webpage navigation and headings. Phone shows timetable and Scan attendance; laptop shows classroom QR and 0/22 roster.
promptSet.scan: Edit the locked master only inside the phone display: OfflineQR scanner, Scan captured, Signed on this device. Preserve laptop and all exterior pixels.
promptSet.offline: Edit the locked master only inside the phone display: Saved on this device, Waiting to sync, Computer Networks, Section A, Queued. Preserve laptop and all exterior pixels.
promptSet.reconcile: Edit the locked master only inside both displays: phone Server accepted, Attendance synchronized, Verified; laptop 1/22 present and one verified row. Preserve all hardware and background.
